newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT V INDIA A.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, OPT TO BAT V INDIA A.

text.p: South Africa won the toss and decided to bat in a three-day game against an Indian A side on Tuesday in the western Indian city of Nagpur.

Teams: South Africa - Hansie Cronje (capt.), Herschelle Gibbs, Darryl Cullinan, John Commins, Brian McMillan, Lance Klusener, Derek Crookes, David Richardson, Nicky Boje, Fanie de Villiers, Paul Adams.
India A - W.V. Raman (capt.), Navjot Sidhu, Vinod Kambli, Ajay Jadeja, Sridhar Sarath, Rajiv Nayyar, Pankaj Dharmani, Sairaj Bahutule, Ashish Kapoor, Sandeep Sharma, D. Ganesh.
